nodes.description: Implement the approved Story, demonstrate RED/GREEN and simplify while green.
nodes.verify: Run related checks and record the changed files and evidence.

nodes.description: Review the final diff against the Story, including failure paths.
nodes.verify: Record findings and evidence; fail with the corrective action if changes are needed.

nodes.description: Run fresh verification after review fixes; prepare raw evidence for G4.
nodes.verify: Record actual commands, exit codes, changed-file scope and unproven boundaries.

output.summary: Lean Office phase 1 (M15/V17/D23) re-checked in a new run because merging main changed the Story (M16 added) after U16. Implementation as in U16 (5f72724: runner seam, lean DB/agents, facade, localhost server, service/CLI, no-build UI, final-review fixes), merged with origin/main (301a07c). The app-be real check found a stall: a claude sonnet reviewer wrote a sentence and then its fenced JSON pass report, and unfence (main code in src/runners/claude-profile.ts) only unwrapped a whole-message fence, so the report read as null and the task stopped with UNKNOWN_RESULT. Fixed TDD in dc6d213 (RED 8/9 -> GREEN 9/9) and, after independent review, 70d3d8a (quoted ``` inside JSON kept, linear time; RED 9/10 -> GREEN 10/10). Replaying the stalled reviewer message gives verdict=pass. root 927/927, typecheck 0.

Phase 1 reviews as in U16: per-task reviews and a whole-branch security review on the strongest model (With fixes; Important 4 and the result-summary gap fixed and re-reviewed). The real-check fix dc6d213 got an independent report-only review: Changes needed, Important 1 (counting ``` across the whole message rejected a fenced-only report whose JSON string quoted ```, which the old code read) and Minor quadratic regex on long blank runs (100K newlines 7.5 s); both fixed in 70d3d8a with RED first. Accepted and documented: the sentence before the block is discarded, and an earlier sentence-and-block draft voids the turn (pinned by test). Boundary unchanged: a report still comes only from the assistant's last text block, never tool output; a review report must carry the runtime candidate digest. Follow-ups found, not fixed here: runner/API error (turn.failed, exit 1) is classified as review fail and reruns build; a stopped lean task has no rerun; OAuth refresh lock left after the model-list probe (suspected).

Fresh verification 2026-10-27 after the last review fix, on 70d3d8a (src/tests clean against HEAD; only docs and run files pending): npm test 927/927, npm run typecheck exit 0, tests/claude-profile.test.mjs 10/10, Story checker exit 0. app-be real check on the restarted lean Office (12:57, after the fix commit dc6d213): task 'LICENSE unchanged check' with agent work claude default / review claude sonnet went story G1 -> plan G1 -> build -> 3 registered checks pass -> review (first attempt blocked by an API safeguard, exit 1, recorded fail and rebuilt; second sonnet review pass) -> G4 with the user's answers -> delivered, no changed files, app-be unchanged. Agent add/rename/runner change/delete, busy and last-agent delete refusals, and the Decisions task link checked. Unproven: codex as review runner (blocked by ~/.codex/AGENTS.md), the sentence-plus-block report path in a live run (the passing review sent bare JSON), other PCs, multi-day use.
